description_en: Queries information about the most recently generated global resource inventory for the current account
description_zh: 获取当前账号最近一次生成的全局资源下载清单信息
name: GetResourceInventory

ResourceInventory.description_en: The information about the global resource inventory
ResourceInventory.description_zh: 全局资源下载清单信息

DownloadUrl.description_en: The download URL of the global resource inventory
DownloadUrl.description_zh: 全局资源清单下载地址

ResourceInventoryGenerateTime.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the inventory started to be generated
ResourceInventoryGenerateTime.description_zh: 下载清单开始生成时的时间戳

Status.description_en:
The generation status of the inventory. Valid values:

CREATING: The inventory is being generated.

COMPLETE: The inventory is generated
Status.description_zh:
下载清单生成状态，取值：

CREATING：生成中
 
COMPLETE：生成完成
